subject.title: fix(codex): require explicit final source delivery

question: Should Codex `message_tool_only` delivery adopt this explicit `final` runtime contract, or retain the existing terminal contract and use the prompt-only candidate?
rationale: Both approaches address the reproduced bug, but this branch creates durable model-facing and plugin-facing API behavior that tests cannot select on maintainers' behalf.

options.title: Approve explicit final
options.body: Keep the structural runtime safeguard, confirm or narrow the Plugin SDK boundary, reconcile the surface gate, and require exact-head live proof before merge.

options.title: Choose prompt-only
options.body: Retain the existing runtime completion contract and land the narrower proof-positive change in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100156 instead.

recommendation.title: Approve explicit final
recommendation.body: Keep the structural runtime safeguard, confirm or narrow the Plugin SDK boundary, reconcile the surface gate, and require exact-head live proof before merge.
